title: La Iglesia
goal: Read how the Church functioned as the colony's real infrastructure, from early universities to semi-autonomous Jesuit missions and an Inquisition that hunted heresy.

items: Name two functions the Church performed beyond religious life.
Describe what the Jesuit 'reducciones' were and how they combined doctrine, the Guaraní language and economic life.
Explain what happened to the reducciones after the Jesuits were expelled in 1767.
Explain where the Inquisition operated and what it persecuted.
Use the gerund to describe two things happening at once.
